blocks.text: With a design that prioritizes comfort, the Comfort Pro Rocker is perfect for tailgates, camping trips, and picnics. A built-in beverage holder in the sturdy armrest safely holds drinks, while a phone pocket holds small devices so you can enjoy the company. Featuring Spring-Action Rocking Technology for smooth rocking on any surface and a simple setup Eazy-Fold, this chair maximizes convenience and can support weights up to 250 lbs. GCI Outdoor was founded in 1996 with one simple mission — to bring premium furniture and gear to outdoor enthusiasts. With clever engineering and cutting-edge design, GCI continues to innovate in exciting ways, delivering new levels of convenience and comfort to folks who enjoy spending quality time outside. From perfect beach days to thrilling concerts, long hikes to ultimate tailgates, GCI will be there as you connect, celebrate, and create amazing moments.

items: OUTDOOR LIVING. Relax by the campfire in the Comfort Pro Rocker, an adult rocking chair from GCI Outdoor. With an easy to carry shoulder strap, grab this chair and head off on new adventures, or into a state of deep relaxation.

A FRONT ROW SEAT. Perfect for sports games or backyard lawn BBQ, the Comfort Pro Rocker is ready to go. With a beverage holder built into the armrest, a secure phone pocket and great back support, you can enjoy more time outside with family and friends.

CUTTING-EDGE DESIGN. Shock absorbers with patented Spring-Action Rocking Technology let you gently rock on flat, hard or soft terrain. A sturdy steel frame holds up to 250 lbs, while a durable mesh backing brings through airflow.

SIMPLE SET UP. Recharge in no time with an easy setup. Just push the backrest and armrests apart and you're good to go. Packing up is just as quick — get behind the chair and pull the high-quality seat frame towards you.
